description: Full d_4 measurement on PSQ-2 v3 fine-tuned Qwen3-1.7B-Base. LoRA adapter merged into base. Tests whether the latent geometry encodes d_4 distances (quasiconvexity, Spearman correlation, permutation null).

pass_criteria.d4_separation: off-diagonal d_4 > 0.1 for Moore-distinct state pairs
pass_criteria.spearman_vs_euclidean: rho > 0.25 and rank 0 out of 100 permutations
pass_criteria.beat_permutation_null: real rho beats 99/100 random endpoint shuffles
